connect.title: WhatsApp number
connect.explainer: Connect this client's own WhatsApp number. Pick with the client how they want to work; either way they log in with Facebook in Meta's window and nothing has to be pasted.

help.wabaId: In the Meta app: WhatsApp, API Setup. It is listed next to the phone number.
help.phoneNumberId: In the Meta app: WhatsApp, API Setup, right under the phone number.
help.appId: In the Meta app: App settings, Basic. It is the first field.
help.appSecret: In the Meta app: App settings, Basic. Press Show next to App secret.
help.accessToken: In Meta Business settings: Users, System users, Generate token. Pick the one that never expires.

connect.secretSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
connect.missing: Fill in all five values first.
connect.digitsOnly: The three IDs are numbers only, without spaces.
connect.pendingNote: These details are saved but not tested yet. Nothing is sent from this number until the test passes.
connect.ok: Connected. Messages can now go out from this number.

errors.no_sender: No WhatsApp details are saved for this account yet.
errors.secrets_unreadable: The saved token or app secret could not be read. Paste both again and save.
errors.token_rejected: Meta does not accept the system user token. It may be mistyped or expired.
errors.number_not_visible: The token cannot see this phone number ID. Check the ID, and that the system user has access to the WhatsApp account.
errors.waba_not_visible: The token cannot see this WhatsApp Business account ID. Check the ID, and that the system user has access to it.
errors.number_not_in_waba: This phone number is not part of that WhatsApp Business account. Check the two IDs.
errors.app_secret_mismatch: The app ID and the app secret do not belong together. Check both under App settings, Basic.
errors.meta_unreachable: Meta could not be reached. Try again in a minute.
errors.number_in_use: This phone number ID is already connected to another account.
errors.secrets_required: The app secret and the token are both needed the first time.
errors.engine_unavailable: The automation engine did not answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.app_secret_missing: The server is missing Lead Awaker's Meta app secret (META_APP_SECRET).
errors.number_unclear: The WhatsApp account has no number, or more than one. Enter the details by hand.
errors.signup_cancelled: The Meta window was closed before it finished.

warnings.app_not_subscribed: Sending works, but incoming messages will not arrive yet: the Meta app is not subscribed to this WhatsApp account.
warnings.webhook_unknown: Could not check whether incoming messages will arrive. Sending works.
warnings.app_unknown: Could not check the app secret right now. Sending works. Press Test connection again later.

connect.manualHelp: For a client who built their own Meta app: paste the five values from their Meta business account.

app.title: Keep WhatsApp on their phone
app.body: The assistant answers on the number the client already uses in the WhatsApp Business app.

points.a: The client sees every chat on their phone, the assistant's replies included
points.b: They can answer a customer themselves from WhatsApp
points.c: What they type themselves costs nothing

app.needs: Needs: the number is on the WhatsApp Business app (not the normal WhatsApp), and the phone is opened at least every two weeks.

new.title: A separate number for the assistant
new.body: A number that only the assistant uses. It is not on anyone's phone.

points.a: The client's own WhatsApp stays private and untouched
points.b: Chats are read and answered in the CRM
points.c: Works with a landline or a new number

new.needs: Needs: a number that is not on WhatsApp yet and can take an SMS or a call for the code.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.explainer: WhatsApp only lets a business start a conversation with a message Meta has approved. These are the standard receptionist messages. Send them to Meta here. Approval usually takes a few minutes.
templates.needsConnection: Connect and test the WhatsApp number first. Then the messages can be sent to Meta.
templates.outdated: Text changed since it was sent
templates.catalogUnavailable: The message texts could not be loaded right now. The statuses below are the last ones saved.

reasons.INVALID_FORMAT: the layout of the message is not allowed
reasons.TAG_CONTENT_MISMATCH: the text does not fit the chosen category
reasons.SCAM: it looks like a scam to Meta

result.submitted_one: {{count}} message sent to Meta for review.
result.submitted_other: {{count}} messages sent to Meta for review.
result.nothing: Everything is already at Meta. Nothing to send.

errors.engine_unavailable: The automation engine did not answer. Try again in a minute.

behaviour.title: How the assistant answers

all.title: Everyone
all.help: Every chat on this number gets an answer.

new_only.title: Only new contacts
new_only.help: People already in the client's phone or chats stay with the client.

off.title: Nobody
off.help: Messages are stored in the CRM; nobody gets an automatic answer.

behaviour.takeoverLabel: When the client replies from their phone
behaviour.takeoverHelp: A reply from the client's WhatsApp app pauses the assistant in that chat. It takes over again when the client sends the command below in the chat, or after the waiting time.
behaviour.commandVisible: The customer sees “{{command}}” in the chat too: WhatsApp sends everything the client types. Turning manual takeover off on the conversation in the CRM hands back without the customer seeing anything.
